{{Quote|Captain, uh, my scopes just picked up a ghost image in our sensor wake.''"<br />"''Probably another glitch like that false biosignature we saw in the cargo hold earlier.|The co-pilot and [[Unidentified captain (1729)|his captain]]|<ref name="BH" />}}
This individual was the '''co-pilot''' of ''[[1729]]'', a [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]] for the [[Desolation Alley]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]]. They noticed an anomaly in the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] wake but, after [[Unidentified captain (1729)|their captain]] had them check again, the co-pilot dismissed it as a glitch. In actuality, the anomaly was [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] using ''1729'' to slip [[Jaster's Legacy|his ship]] past the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] surrounding Desolation Alley.

==Behind the scenes==
''1729{{'s}}'' co-pilot's only appearance has been in a cutscene in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', in which he was voiced by [[Robin Atkin Downes]].
